name: rsna-knee-2026-experiment-ledger schema
description: Column definitions for submissions.csv (one row per official Kaggle submission) and experiments.csv (one row per method family). Scores are Kaggle public-leaderboard AUC values as returned by the submissions API, rounded by Kaggle to three decimals. Version 1.3.0 removes the runtime_note column and internal build labels, and quotes Kaggle submission descriptions verbatim in notes. Version 1.2.0 quoted Kaggle's errorDescription verbatim in no_score_reason.

submissions.csv.grain: one row per official submission by team prvsiyan to rsna-knee-abnormality-detection

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: Kaggle submission reference id (ref in the submissions API), stored as text: an integer written in digits. Unique.

columns.name: utc
columns.description: Submission timestamp as recorded by Kaggle, truncated to whole seconds. Format: ISO 8601 with Z suffix.

columns.name: notebook_kind
columns.description: public = the team's public notebook category; bench = the team's private validation notebook category; unrecorded = the sources do not establish the category (51 rows). Not a claim about current Kaggle visibility.

columns.name: family_id
columns.description: Method family identifier. Joins to experiments.csv family_id.

columns.name: method
columns.description: Short human-written method label. Campaign build labels are not used in this release; public notebook 'version N' is the Kaggle notebook version.

columns.name: components
columns.description: Models, checkpoints and readers named in the row, with upstream credit where the row description names one. Checkpoints are named, not redistributed. Team annotations are labelled.

columns.name: weights
columns.description: Blend weights as predeclared in the row description, or 'none (single arm)', or 'not recorded in the row description'.

columns.name: public_score
columns.description: Kaggle publicScore for the row. Empty when status is NO_SCORE. Higher is better. Differences of 0.001 are one leaderboard tick and are within noise.

columns.name: status
columns.description: SCORED = Kaggle returned a public score. NO_SCORE = the hidden rerun failed or produced no file.

columns.name: no_score_reason
columns.description: Kaggle's errorDescription for a NO_SCORE row, quoted verbatim from the Kaggle submissions API (snapshot of 10 October 2026, 11:47:18 UTC). Empty for SCORED rows.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the row relative to its family. reference = baseline, control or best of its family; plateau = same level as the reference; tie = within one tick, not adopted; rejected = below the reference or not adopted under the team's annotation; superseded = replaced by a later lineage; candidate_efficiency = a candidate for the efficiency final, pending the team's decision; failed_rerun = no score; degraded_rerun = scored but the output was degraded (near-constant table). The reference value covers three cases: a family baseline, a control reproduction, or the best arm of a family.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Verbatim quotes from the Kaggle submission description (marked with [...] where abridged), score comparisons and row ids. Judgements that are not in the Kaggle description are labelled Team annotation. No runtimes and no local identifiers are included.

columns.name: family_id
columns.description: Family identifier, e.g. F13_mirror_reader. Joins to submissions.csv family_id.

columns.name: family_name
columns.description: Human-readable family name.

columns.name: method_summary
columns.description: One-sentence description of what the family tried.

columns.name: n_rows
columns.description: Number of official submissions in the family, including NO_SCORE rows.

columns.name: n_scored
columns.description: Number of family rows with a public score.

columns.name: n_no_score
columns.description: Number of family rows without a score (failed reruns, runtime limit).

columns.name: best_public_score
columns.description: Highest public score in the family.

columns.name: best_row_id
columns.description: Earliest row id that attains best_public_score in the family. Stored as text, digits only.

columns.name: min_public_score
columns.description: Lowest scored public score in the family (shows degraded or failed arms).

columns.name: mean_public_score
columns.description: Unweighted mean of scored rows in the family. Dominated by family size and by degraded rows; read with min and best.

columns.name: first_utc
columns.description: Earliest submission in the family. Format: ISO 8601 with Z suffix.

columns.name: last_utc
columns.description: Latest submission in the family. Format: ISO 8601 with Z suffix.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: Family-level status: reference, plateau, rejected, superseded, tie or candidate_efficiency (same vocabulary as submissions.csv outcome).

columns.name: verdict
columns.description: One-paragraph verdict with the evidence row ids; team annotations are labelled.

efficiency_formula.md.description: Efficiency Prize formula as recorded by the team, constants (illustrative), worked examples and what is and is not measured in this dataset.

units.AUC: area under the ROC curve on the Kaggle public split; dimensionless, 0 to 1

missing_values: Empty cell means not applicable or not recorded in the source. No sentinel values are used.

field_conventions.build_labels: Campaign build labels are not used in this release. In public-notebook rows, 'version N' is the Kaggle notebook version (see README.md Glossary).
field_conventions.reference_outcome: reference covers three cases: a family baseline, a control reproduction, or the best arm of a family. Filter on family_id to tell them apart.
